biomarkers.name: NRAS
biomarkers.clinical_use: No standard targeted therapy; may support MEK inhibitor trial eligibility

biomarkers.name: KIT
biomarkers.clinical_use: Imatinib in selected activating KIT-mutant cases

biomarkers.name: PD-L1, TMB
biomarkers.clinical_use: Immunotherapy may be considered, but PD-L1/TMB are not established conjunctival melanoma-specific companion biomarkers

biomarkers.name: NF1
biomarkers.clinical_use: No established standard targeted therapy; biologically relevant recurrent driver

biomarkers.name: TERT promoter
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent driver alteration; no standard targeted therapy

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Atypical melanocytes at conjunctival epithelium with variable dermal (substantia propria) invasion
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not formally graded; tumour thickness and location drive prognosis

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Intermediate — closer to cutaneous than uveal in terms of TMB and immunotherapy responsiveness

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neural crest — melanocytes at conjunctival mucosal surface
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Melanocytic differentiation with same lineage markers as cutaneous
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Biology is intermediate between cutaneous and mucosal melanoma — with higher BRAF frequency than most mucosal melanomas and more UV-signature TMB than mucosal melanoma, though not uniformly identical to cutaneous melanoma
